admission.justification: A future UI change must not bypass writer admission or authoritative gate visibility through a private review-only disposition path.

alternatives.option: Keep disposition authoring in the existing writer with author, task and authority provenance and gate visibility.
alternatives.reason: Appendix151 specifies the writer, where the gate sees dispositions. review_record_rendering.submission explicitly reports the read-only surface and directs authoring to that owner rather than shipping a substitute write route.

alternatives.option: Publish judgments through a private reviewer mutation route or local controls outside the existing writer and gate.
alternatives.reason: It would create another authoring authority and hide or weaken admission/provenance the existing writer and gate enforce.
alternatives.reconsider_when: An approved requirement explicitly delegates a review authoring route while preserving the existing provenance, admission and gate contract.

consequences: A future UI change must not bypass writer admission or authoritative gate visibility through a private review-only disposition path.
No new serving authoring endpoint, no assertion that this rendering module executes the writer/gate, and no automatic memory acceptance.
context: Approved MIK-R57@v2 appendix83/151 and rule6 require this by-design choice to be recorded, not deferred as a gap. Source obligation: MIK-R57@v2 by-design writer-authority. This is the requirement-prescribed boundary, not a claim that an undocumented alternative was seriously weighed.
decider: Approved MIK-R57@v2 under D18/D47/D48; Curator records the specified boundary under constrains_future_work.
